hero.eyebrow: Born in the Balkans. Made to be remembered.
hero.title: When your heart says ćevapi
hero.copy: Good food. A full table. One more story. Pull up a chair — this is the Walter way.
hero.scroll: A little further. A little hungrier.
hero.caption: The taste that brings us together.

signature.copy: Our signature ćevapi: beef, our own recipe and a warm somun. A simple pleasure, made to be shared.
signature.label: The original gathering food.
signature.detail: Walter's official menu describes beef ćevapi, 125 g or 250 g, served in half a homemade somun, 150 g. Accompaniments and availability depend on the restaurant.
signature.allergens: For confirmed ingredients and allergens, ask your chosen restaurant. The illustrative image is not a serving specification.

story.copy: A table worth gathering around. Food with its roots in the Balkans. Walter brings traditional flavours into a contemporary, welcoming setting.
story.yearCopy: Walter has been welcoming guests since 2004.
story.nowCopy: The same love of good food. New tables to gather around.
story.quote: Come for the ćevapi. Stay for the feeling.

careerPage.intro: Behind every good meal are great people. Join the Walter team and build your experience in hospitality alongside colleagues you can grow with.
careerPage.applicationNote: Complete your application on Walter's official website.
careerPage.photoCaption: People are our most important ingredient.
careerPage.benefitsCopy: From your first restaurant experience to new professional challenges, growth starts with a willingness to learn and a supportive team.
careerPage.learningCopy: Learn working standards, develop your skills and gain experience through Walter's training programme.
careerPage.teamCopy: Hospitality is a team effort. We share knowledge, support colleagues and create a great guest experience together.
careerPage.growthCopy: Walter encourages professional development. Many team members started in restaurants and continued their careers in other roles.
careerPage.nextCopy: Interested in hospitality? Explore roles and submit an application through Walter's official recruitment page.
careerPage.contactCopy: Can't find a suitable role? You can email your CV to the HR team or call with further questions.

catering.intro: When your favourite people get together, bring Walter to the table. Catering for business events, celebrations and family moments.

catering.celebrationCopy: Another candle. Another year together. Celebrate with the food you love.
catering.familyCopy: Family traditions, reunions and those days best spent together around a full table.
catering.serviceCopy: Walter prepares, arranges and delivers food to an agreed address. Talk to our team about dishes and the details of your event.
